name: speech
description: Text-to-speech narration. The narrate skill turns a script into narration.wav plus words.json, with a start and end time per word. The default backend runs Kokoro-82M locally. The optional elevenlabs backend sends the text to the third-party ElevenLabs API (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or vault-exec) after showing the character count against your quota, caching repeats; an organization can forbid it. You install espeak-ng (GPL-3.0); a hook installs Python packages, setup the models, check reports gaps.

elevenlabs_model.title: ElevenLabs model
elevenlabs_model.description: Model id the elevenlabs backend uses when a run names none, one of the ids in the MODELS table of scripts/elevenlabs.py. Unset keeps the script's default.

model_dir.title: Kokoro model directory
model_dir.description: Folder that holds the downloaded Kokoro model set (a kokoro-<revision> subfolder per pin), for a larger disk or one cache shared across worktrees and plugins. Unset keeps it under the plugin data directory's models folder.
